posts.cooked:
Please refer to PYQ discussion session recording for more details.

Here we are supposed to choose which version of ps and grep combined correctly give us the PID of the daily-backup process.

The daily-backup process is visible in the output of ps x, and not the others, so we use that.

There is another process called daily-backuper which is a superstring of the string "daily-backup", hence we have to use \b word boundary regex.
